title: What is the Meaning of Work?
description: A depressed Iaune is eating fries...

mainQuestExcel.title: What is the Meaning of Work?
mainQuestExcel.description: A depressed Iaune is eating fries...

dialogs.text: Oh, good gulls. I know that you are hungry, but I, too, have not eaten my fill.
Forget it. I suppose that it's all good if you're happy...
What are you doing?
Traveler? Why, what a pleasant surprise. If you're here to make a request of me, I'm afraid you'll have to wait. I'm not quite done with my fries yet.
Oh, I'm not here on business.
Oh, is that so? That's good. I need to hurry up and finish them as soon as possible...
Well, this is my main meal. I'll be going out with Roialte on business later, so I need to rush this meal.
I'm not used to eating inside the Palais Mermonia, so I tend to go outside and find a quiet spot to get my meal squared away real quick.
But today... I don't know what's making these gulls go wild, but they're coming at my fries all at once, and no matter how much they eat, it's not enough.
Well, there's a lot of them, and only this many fries...
That's true. But I can't feed every single seagull in the ocean, can I...
Well, these are your fries, aren't they? Don't let the gulls get at them just like that.
You'll go hungry at this rate, y'know?
You seem a little down, actually.
Really? I'm not... Well, actually, I suppose I am. Nothing escapes you, I see.
I just... don't know what the meaning of my work is. I busy myself every day at the Maison Gestion, but I don't really see it bearing tangible fruit.
I haven't been able to help anyone, nor has anyone's life been made more convenient by my work. Roialte says that our work is very important, but...
I just sit in front of a typewriter and clatter away, endlessly. What purpose does that serve? I might as well just lose another keycap. At least that'll make Estelle a bit of Mora...
Sorry. I know I shouldn't be saying all this, but I just feel rather lost right now no matter what I do. Maybe... Maybe I need more time.
Finish eating first.
You're right. But the amount of time we have now is insufficient to go get some new fries.
Forget it, I'll just give the rest of them to the birds. I'll just get something to eat once Roialte and I are done with our business.
It'll take us... What, half a day? Not too long, I'd reckon.
Will you be able to hold up after not eating for that long?
Leave the gulls to me.
Um... Wouldn't that be too much trouble? All that over some fries...
Just eat your meal. You shouldn't go hungry, no matter how busy you are.
I'll take care of those gulls.
Let's solve your gull problem first.
You seem a little off your game.
Not all of them have gotten something to eat just yet...
And why are you eating fries over here?
Ah, Violetgold Angler Gulls. Once you're done with these fries, please leave...
How's the situation right now?
No, not at all. When the gulls came for my fries, it turned tail and hid behind me, trembling.
*sigh* Not that I blame the dog. Its breed have only ever had one duty — to love others and be loved by them. It has never learned to attack anything in its life.
We have this duty too, you know.
Perhaps. But in some circumstances, love, too, may be considered a "right." And where those things are concerned, things tend to proceed in difficult directions...
Sorry, I've said too much. I've had to handle many disputes of an emotional bent today, and I fear I haven't quite sorted myself out yet.
*sigh* But right now, my most pressing task is to figure out how to safely finish my fries...
Did getting a dog work out for you?
We will chase them all away.
Sure, but could you focus on... only chasing them away? They just want my fries, but there's no malice in them.
Well, it is a bad thing for me, but it's not a very serious matter, so... Please, just chase them away, would you?
We'll find something else to feed them.
Hmm? That's not a bad idea. But can you really feed that many of them?
Well... Even if you can't, you just need to buy me enough time to eat my fries. Alright then, I leave this to you.

flow.stepDescription: Chase away the Violetgold Angler Gull

dialogs.text: The document that Roialte wants is... No, wait, I think I have this data wrong...

flow.stepDescription: Chase away the Violetgold Angler Gull again

dialogs.text: The document that Roialte wants is... No, wait, I think I have this data wrong...
Thank you. I'll finish up my fries while they're gone.
*sigh* But what do I do next time? I can't always count on your help, can I?
Y—You really don't do things by halves, do you? All the gulls in the area have been scared off...
Thank you. I'll finish up my fries while they're not around to disturb me.
*sigh* But what do I do next time? I can't always count on your help, can I?
Have you tried getting a dog?
You mean... I should get a dog to chase them off?
That's not a bad plan. I might be able to get someone to lend me one...
Um, try eating somewhere else?
I can't find anywhere better to eat now, anyway. If I'm too close to the Palais Mermonia, I might bump into one of my colleagues.
And then I'll get dragged into their discussions of work again...
But if I go too far away, I won't be able to get back to the office on time, and I might miss something important.
Considering these two factors, this place is my only option.
